title: Axe Throwing
tagline: Turn it once and bite the bull.
description: A calm target sport from the lumber-camp traditions of Canada and the United States. Aim at the painted board, let go on the swing so the axe turns exactly once, and out-score a league rival across four venues with wind and a sliding board.
howToPlay: Press the board to aim; drag to place the reticle.
The swing marker sweeps: let go inside a green band.
A good swing turns the axe once and the blade bites in.
Rings score 6 to 1; the corner spots are worth 7.
Read wind and the sliding board; use Think for a hint.
